name: doctor
summary: One read-only command that checks the hub is wired and healthy, and prints the exact fix for anything that is not.

env.LEDGER_PATH: optional: ledger file to check instead of $HUBKIT_HOME/state/ledger.jsonl
env.DISK_GUARD_WARN_GI: WARN below this many GiB free, default 20
env.DISK_GUARD_CRIT_GI: FAIL below this many GiB free, default 5
env.DOCTOR_SETTINGS: optional: settings file to check instead of ~/.claude/settings.json
